title: Sorbitol Washing Complex Homogenate for Improved DNA Extractions
author: Ashley Jones
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.beuvjew6

steps.title: Prepare sorbitol wash solution
steps.instruction: Prepare a 500 mL sorbitol wash solution. Store at 4°C for up to 6 months.

steps.title: Grind tissue
steps.instruction: Grind tissue to a fine powder, keeping it frozen with liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Prepare sample in tube
steps.instruction: Transfer homogenate to an appropriate sized tube, ensuring the tissue does not exceed 33% of the tube capacity.

steps.title: Add sorbitol wash solution
steps.instruction: Fill the tube capacity with an excess of sorbitol wash solution (approximately 2x volume of tube capacity will be used per sample).

steps.title: Add reducing agent
steps.instruction: Add either DTT or β-Mercaptoethanol freshly to the wash solution.

substeps.instruction: For DTT: Add 0.15 mg DTT per 1 mL of sorbitol wash to achieve an approximate final concentration of 1 mM (DTT MW = 154.253).
Alternatively, for β-Mercaptoethanol: Add 10 µL of 1% β-Mercaptoethanol (v/v) per 1 mL of sorbitol wash.

steps.title: Mix sample
steps.instruction: Shake, invert, and vortex to mix thoroughly, ensuring the tissue is in suspension.

steps.title: Centrifuge sample
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at room temperature for 5 min.

substeps.instruction: Use 5,000 rcf (or reduce to 2,500 rcf if tubes contain ball bearings to prevent rupturing).

steps.title: Decant supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully decant the supernatant, removing as much wash solution as possible without losing the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Note: Supernatant should appear slightly cloudy or discoloured light yellow or brown.

steps.title: Evaluate and repeat wash
steps.instruction: Inspect the decanted supernatant; if it was turbid, viscous, or had dark discolouration, repeat the sorbitol wash process.

steps.title: Proceed to DNA extraction
steps.instruction: Add lysis buffer to the pellet and proceed with the DNA extraction method of choice.
